businessGoal: Enable visitors to easily find products by category.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the category page is displayed when a category name is clicked.
Verify that the category name is shown as the page title on the category page.
Verify that only products belonging to the selected category are shown on the category page.

clarifications: Behavior when clicking on an invalid or non-existent category is not specified.
Handling of categories with no products is not mentioned.
